The defect is narrower: adjudication §6 and profile §7 affirm that Stage 2 “does not change the null result” / “pairwise relation counts.” Stage 2 was forbidden to compare. AX3 is a general-`W` representation claim of the same *kind* the null control already typed as E2 at a narrower selected-process K9 scope (`PMNC-K9-01`), while `PMNC-K9-03` remained unresolved. An invariance claim about those pairwise records is a pairwise-level scientific statement issued without pairwise authority (F4). It is not a silent award of convergence credit.

**T15.** Immediate second search, non-null pairwise, empirical discriminator, demotion, recurrence, and method clarification are declined with stated reasons. Selecting this audit before any AX3-dependent pairwise reopen is consistent: attacking AX3 first is the higher-information dependency order. “No immediate new substantive science” is supported.
